category: Consumables, Cooked Foods, Chems, and Mutated Buffs

rules.foodStacking: Only ONE food buff can be active per primary stat or effect type. Consuming a food of the same type overwrites the previous buff.
rules.chemStacking: Only ONE primary chem buff can be active at a time (e.g. Berry Mentats, Psychotats, Overdrive). Consuming another chem immediately replaces the active chem buff.
rules.alcoholStacking: Only ONE alcohol buff can be active at a time. Overwritten upon drinking another alcohol.
